questions.stem: Identical twins have the same genes but may differ in body mass. What does this suggest?

options.text: Body mass is influenced by both genes and the environment
Identical twins do not actually share the same genes
Body mass is only determined by the environment
Body mass is only determined by genes

questions.explanation: Since identical twins share the same genes but can differ in body mass, this shows that environmental factors (such as diet and exercise) also play a role. Body mass is influenced by both genes and the environment.
